title: MSc Digital Marketing (2027 entry) | The University of Manchester

facts.fact: For entry in the academic year beginning September 2027, the annual tuition fee for the MSc Digital Marketing (full-time) for UK students is £19,300.
For entry in the academic year beginning September 2027, the annual tuition fee for the MSc Digital Marketing (full-time) for international, including EU, students is £34,800.
The University of Manchester reserves the right to increase tuition fees by up to 7% each year for courses lasting more than one year.
facts.quote: reserves the right to increase your tuition fee by up to 7% each year for courses lasting more than one year

facts.fact: International students must pay a tuition fee deposit of £2,500 by the deadline in their offer letter to confirm their place on the MSc Digital Marketing course.
facts.quote: you will be required to pay £2,500 by the deadline stated in your offer letter to confirm your place

facts.fact: Graduates of The University of Manchester and Manchester Metropolitan University can receive a 10% discount on master's tuition fees under the Manchester Alumni Loyalty Discount scheme.
facts.quote: Graduates of The University of Manchester and Manchester Metropolitan University can receive a 10% discount

facts.fact: The MSc Digital Marketing ranked 4th in the UK and 15th in the world for marketing in the QS Business Masters Ranking 2027, according to the university.
facts.quote: ranked 4th in the UK and 15th in the world for marketing (QS Business Masters Ranking 2027)

facts.fact: The university requires a First or Upper Second class honours degree (2:1, with 60% average) from a UK university or overseas equivalent for entry.
facts.quote: We require a First or Upper Second class honours degree (2:1, with 60% average)

facts.fact: Some English Language test results are only valid for two years, and the test report must be valid on the course start date.
facts.quote: Some English Language test results are only valid for two years.

facts.fact: A deferral of an offer is allowed for only one year and must be requested directly from the admissions team.
facts.quote: You can only defer your offer for one year.

facts.fact: The university's policy aims for students to complete programmes without extra costs beyond tuition; unavoidable compulsory additional costs above 1% of the annual home undergraduate fee must be disclosed at application.
facts.quote: Any unavoidable additional compulsory costs totalling more than 1% of the annual home undergraduate fee per annum

facts.fact: The university requires first and second year transcripts, which may be scanned copies at application time, as part of an application.
facts.quote: first and second year transcript (scanned copies are accepted at the time of application)

facts.fact: The MSc Digital Marketing (2027 entry) requires students to take 180 credits in total.
facts.quote: During the course, you will be taking 180 credits in total.

facts.fact: The eight taught modules in semesters 1 and 2 of the MSc Digital Marketing total 120 credits.
facts.quote: The eight taught modules during semesters 1 and 2 will total 120 credits.

facts.fact: The Summer Period Applied Digital Marketing Project on the MSc Digital Marketing is worth 60 credits.
facts.quote: Summer Period: Applied Digital Marketing Project (60 credits)

facts.fact: The MSc Digital Marketing does not offer an individual dissertation.
facts.quote: Please note that an individual dissertation is not available on this programme.

facts.fact: The MSc Digital Marketing course unit list is mandatory for BMAN74930, which carries 60 credits, while the other mandatory units listed carry 15 credits each.
The course unit table on the MSc Digital Marketing page shows 10 of 13 course units, with a link to display all course units.
